subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: tenant identity and SKU mapping for Redwood Inference — registration runbook
messages:
From: Alyssa Carter <alyssa.carter@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboarding@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace onboarding: tenant identity & SKU mapping

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for starting the marketplace registration. To complete publisher activation we need a few items from your side so the validation team can assert your tenant identity and SKU definitions for co-sell. Please send the following: 

- Tenant GUID (subscription-level) and the validated domain proof (TXT/DNS or corporate email sample)
- Publisher identity artifacts (DUNS + W9 or equivalent for US entities)
- SKU mapping file that ties each SKU to pricing tier and metering model (consumption, flat, BYOL)
- A point of contact for technical validation (engineer + schedule window)

I attached the publisher identity checklist we use. If you can drop the tenant GUID and a draft SKU mapping by EOD Tue (10/13) we can queue you for the technical gate on Wed.

Attachment: publisher_identity_req.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Alyssa Carter
Partner Onboarding, Microsoft Commercial Marketplace
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Carter <alyssa.carter@microsoft.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace onboarding: tenant identity & SKU mapping

Alyssa —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers and plan: 

- Tenant GUID: we’ll extract and confirm tonight (Marissa).
- Domain proof: we prefer DNS TXT verification; we can provide a screenshot of the DNS record or add the TXT if MS prefers.
- DUNS/W9: attached (redacted copy) + company registration PDF.
- SKU mapping: attaching a first-pass CSV (sku-mapping-template.csv) with proposed pricing tiers. Jonas and Karthik are looped in to confirm the SKU names align with how the runtime exposes them.

Open question for your team: do you require tenant-level subscription validation or will a publisher-managed tenant assertion suffice for co-sell enablement? We have a private deployment workflow that uses a separate tenant entity in a partner subscription and want to ensure we provide the right GUID.

Attachments: redwood_publisher_proof.zip (manifest + screenshots), sku-mapping-template.csv (csv)

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Wed 10/14 10:00am PT to run through the SKU mapping and validation steps — does that work?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194
From: Alyssa Carter <alyssa.carter@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboarding@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace onboarding: tenant identity & SKU mapping

Marissa —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from validation: 

- Tenant assertion: we need the tenant GUID that will be shown on the publisher account (the publisher tenant). If you have a separate partner-managed tenant, provide both and flag the primary publisher tenant.
- Domain proof: TXT is preferred. Screenshot is okay as interim evidence but we will still require a DNS TXT verification during the final gate.
- DUNS/W9: the redacted PDF is fine for initial review; full docs are required before offer publication.

I attached our short runbook for identity claim steps and a DocuSign link for the publisher agreement. If you sign the agreement by Tue EOD and confirm the tenant GUID, we’ll reserve an engineering slot Wed 10/14 at 10:00am PT.

Related link: https://msft.sharepoint.com/sites/marketplace/onboarding/RedwoodInference
Attachment: identity_claim_steps.md (text)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&v=2

Regards,
Alyssa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace onboarding: tenant identity & SKU mapping

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick internal notes after reviewing their runbook: 

- Action 1: Normalize SKU identifiers coming from runtime team so they match the SKU mapping CSV (remove internal prefixes, keep semantic names). Responsible: Karthik, ETA EOD Tue.
- Action 2: Add a standard tenant proof checklist to our onboarding runbook (steps for DNS TXT, sample screenshot, DUNS upload path). Responsible: Jonas, ETA Wed morning.
- Action 3: Decide which tenant GUID to present as publisher primary — need legal on call if it's a partner-managed tenancy. Marissa, can you confirm the legal lead?

Also, suggest we pre-populate answers to their security/compliance gating questions (SOC2 scope, data residency) before the technical slot. Saves time on the call.

-Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Carter <alyssa.carter@microsoft.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00

Alyssa —

Thanks — we’ll proceed as follows: 

- I uploaded full DUNS and company registration to the SharePoint link you provided (redwood_publisher_proof.zip contains redacted copies for the thread).
- Tenant GUID: primary publisher tenant is 9f3a7c1d-2b4d-4e8f-a9c7-5d8e2f2b6c9a (we’ll prepare DNS TXT entry tonight and will share a screenshot + TXT value once propagated).
- SKU mapping: Karthik will finalize the normalized CSV and send before the Wed call.
- Legal: looping in our counsel offline; I’ll confirm whether partner-managed tenancy needs a separate DPA.

Can you confirm the Wed 10/14 10:00am PT slot for technical validation and co-sell enablement steps? Also if there are any required security docs I should pre-populate, point me to the template.
